name: Modular Seed Foundry
actions: compose a bounded modular growth seed
download or copy a self-contained platform growth brief
summary: Turn one human direction into a portable family of bounded modular seeds that an AI platform can grow, while preserving lineage, contracts, evidence gaps and human-controlled intake.
notes: Seeds are plans, not installed capabilities. Growth is one explicitly initiated platform run at a time; generated candidates still require AXM intake and review.
